brief: A desk organiser: two two-storey columns at the back and three one-storey cells in front of them, the viewer at the front. Back row: the left column with an open bin on its top storey holding a pencil cup; the right column capped with a cover carrying a coiled cable. Front row, left to right: a half cell with a drawer that opens toward the viewer, a full cell with a cover carrying a phone, and a full cell with a cover carrying a mug with a pen standing in it. Use look to check that the drawer faces the view and every prop is visible.

Front is the -z/drawer side (az 180), where every prop is visible and the drawer faces the viewer. check_build clear.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
